jobs.use: Five Thunder Strike main column (owner chose 13/11: sharp two-bolt, platinum grade)
jobs.prompt: Living electricity: two thick main lightning bolts run from the small ink cloud down to the ground, made of sharp straight segments joined at hard angles; they flicker and re-strike violently, their jagged paths snap to new angles again and again while staying thick and keeping a dark gap between them; bright white cores race up and down the bolts; small sharp sparks jump off the corners; thin side branches crackle out and vanish; the base bursts with electric arcs crawling over the ground and grit kicking up; the cloud flashes from inside and stays small. Keep the subject from the first frame: one upright column, same width and height, centred, base on the same line. Locked camera, no zoom, no tilt, uniform pure black background, nothing new enters the frame. Palette lock: ivory white and pale gold only. No saturated yellow, no orange, no blue, no violet.
jobs.why: owner 13/11 15:3x: approved recoloured sharp column (379j try1); "ưu tiên video này trước"
